name: rdp-status-refresh
firstError: A manual refresh left the Overview at 正在确认 / 等待首次观测. No usable initial status became visible and the Start control remained unavailable.
logProvenance: Operator-pasted excerpt, preserved as UTF-8 with LF. The operator account outside the RDP session could not read the on-disk app.log.

findings.runtimeProvisioning: Log shows integrated runtime provisioned and verified at 11:40:28.868 UTC.
findings.panelLock: owner-lock is logged after acquiring PanelLifetime.0. Both acquisitions shown took 1–2 ms. This is not a status command trace.
findings.sourceHypothesis: The managed Windows 2.99.0 Status path requests a process-local Owner with create=false. If no Owner is known, the native path can return unknown; the shared projection may retain its initial Loading state, leaving no Start action. The actual Status return is absent from the excerpt.

integrationHandoff: Verify the first full and light Status in a fresh admitted Windows 2.99.0 HOME before any Start. Distinguish positively verified idle from unknown and expose an explicit blocked state for unknown. Preserve the 5-second Status budget and deny lifecycle actions for unknown. Freeze a new candidate only after a directed check.
